items.title: test(safety): enforce schema parity between src/validation.js and backend/app/main.py
items.summary: Frontend input bounds (`src/validation.js`) and FastAPI bounds (`NUMERIC_RANGES` / `BOOLEAN_FEATURES` in `backend/app/main.py`) are maintained in two files with no automated cross-check.
items.motivation: If a numeric range or categorical enum (`sex`, `vhd`, `region_rwma`, `smoking`/`ex_smoker` mutual exclusion) drifts between browser demo mode and FastAPI mode, one path accepts inputs the other rejects.
acceptance_criteria: Export machine-readable bounds/enums from `src/validation.js` (or shared JSON spec) and assert exact parity against `NUMERIC_RANGES`, `BOOLEAN_FEATURES`, `sex`, and `vhd` in `backend/tests/test_smoke.py`
Verify both frontend and backend reject simultaneous `smoking: true` and `ex_smoker: true`, non-integer `region_rwma`, and diagnostic leakage keys (`CAD`, `Cath`, `LAD`, `LCX`, `RCA`)
All existing Node and pytest checks remain green

items.title: feat(explainability): surface fold dispersion (mean ± SD, Brier, PR-AUC) per vessel head in UI and API
items.summary: `backend/artifacts/metrics.json` records repeated stratified 5-fold CV dispersion showing LCX (`ROC-AUC 0.727`, `Brier 0.215`) and RCA (`0.709`, `0.220`) perform substantially worse than overall CAD (`0.936`, `0.102`), yet vessel cards display raw uncalibrated point scores without head-specific performance context.
items.motivation: In a research tool, showing `0.62` on RCA next to `0.62` on CAD without head-level validation context invites over-interpretation of the weaker vessel heads (`docs/model-card.md`).
acceptance_criteria: Expose per-target CV summary (`roc_auc`, `pr_auc`, `brier`, mean ± SD across folds, and `n=303` cohort note) from `backend/artifacts/metrics.json` via the API metadata endpoint and bundled static fallback
Display each selected vessel head's internal CV ROC-AUC ± SD and Brier score alongside its uncalibrated score in `src/App.jsx`
Keep explicit copy stating these are internal CV summaries, not patient-level confidence intervals or clinical probabilities

items.title: feat(vis): add colorblind-safe palette toggle and non-WebGL schematic fallback in HeartScene.jsx
items.summary: `src/HeartScene.jsx` encodes score intensity solely via a teal-amber-rose (`#2aa99a` -> `#e2b04a` -> `#d84d70`) color ramp and assumes `THREE.WebGLRenderer` creation always succeeds.
items.motivation: Color-only encoding is hard to distinguish under deuteranopia/protanopia, and headless browsers, locked-down VMs, or disabled WebGL contexts throw on `new THREE.WebGLRenderer()` instead of degrading cleanly.
acceptance_criteria: Add a high-contrast / colorblind-safe Viridis- or Okabe-Ito-inspired vessel ramp option alongside numeric badge labels so vessel state never relies on hue alone
Catch WebGL context creation failure in `src/HeartScene.jsx` and render an accessible 2D SVG/card schematic fallback allowing LAD, LCX, and RCA selection without crashing
Extract pure color-ramp and fallback helpers with unit tests under `tests/`

items.title: feat(api): add reproducible research JSON report export with bundle SHA-256 and PHI-key firewall
items.summary: Researchers inspecting synthetic cases cannot currently export a self-describing, reproducible JSON record tying an estimate to the exact model artifact hash, schema version, and uncalibrated disclaimer.
items.motivation: Reproducible research requires versioned, self-documenting outputs (`docs/prevention-risk-plan.md` §5), and any export surface must strictly reject unexpected identifier/PHI fields.
acceptance_criteria: Reject input payloads containing unexpected keys or identifier-named fields (`name`, `patient_id`, `mrn`, `dob`, `email`, `phone`, `address`) in both `src/validation.js` and `backend/app/main.py`

Add a reproducible JSON report builder/download including `schema_version`, `mode` (`trained_research` vs `synthetic_demo`), `model_bundle_sha256`, `scikit_learn_version`, validated synthetic inputs, uncalibrated head outputs, log-odds contributions, and mandatory non-clinical disclaimer
Add pytest and `node:test` coverage verifying deterministic structure and PHI-key refusal

items.title: feat(safety): add client and FastAPI identifier/free-text guard against accidental PHI entry
items.summary: `README.md` warns never to enter names, identifiers, or PHI, and code-level enforcement should back up that prose warning.
items.motivation: A safety boundary enforced in code (`src/validation.js` and `backend/app/main.py`) is strictly stronger than a banner warning alone.
acceptance_criteria: Enforce a closed allowlist of the 22 canonical predictor keys (plus documented aliases in `backend/app/main.py`), rejecting unknown keys with HTTP 422 / validation errors
Ensure FastAPI error responses never echo raw unvalidated free-text payloads into logs
Add unit tests in `tests/validation.test.js` and `backend/tests/test_smoke.py`

items.title: feat(model): record out-of-fold calibration bins, slope, and intercept in backend/ml/train.py
items.summary: `docs/model-card.md` notes no post-hoc calibration is applied and reports Brier score only; researchers cannot inspect whether uncalibrated scores over- or under-predict across deciles/fifths.
items.motivation: `docs/prevention-risk-plan.md` §5 explicitly calls for calibration plots, calibration slope, and intercept alongside ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, and Brier score.
acceptance_criteria: Compute out-of-fold quantile calibration bins (mean predicted score vs observed fraction), calibration slope, and calibration intercept for `Cath`, `LAD`, `LCX`, and `RCA` in `backend/ml/train.py`
Add unit tests on a synthetic stratified DataFrame verifying bin counts, monotonicity/bounds, and zero target leakage
Document how to interpret uncalibrated slope/intercept in `docs/model-card.md`

items.title: feat(vis): keyboard vessel navigation, ARIA live announcements, and camera view presets
items.summary: Rotating the 3D coronary schematic and picking vessels in `src/HeartScene.jsx` relies primarily on pointer raycasting and drag controls.
items.motivation: Keyboard-only users and structured demo walkthroughs benefit from deterministic camera presets (Anterior, LAO, RAO, Reset) and screen-reader announcements when switching between LAD, LCX, and RCA.
acceptance_criteria: Add Anterior / LAO / RAO / Reset view buttons and keyboard shortcuts (`1`/`2`/`3` or arrow keys) synced with `activeVessel`
Announce selected vessel name, mode, and uncalibrated research status via an `aria-live="polite"` region
Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` by disabling auto-rotation/tweening when requested

items.title: feat(model): subgroup & missing-input sensitivity diagnostics for internal CV
items.summary: `docs/model-card.md` notes single-source spectrum bias and absence of subgroup reporting across sex and age strata.
items.motivation: Surfacing subgroup sample sizes (`n`) and metric dispersion highlights small-cohort uncertainty directly inside the evaluation pipeline (`docs/prevention-risk-plan.md` §5).
acceptance_criteria: Add a subgroup summary helper in `backend/ml/train.py` computing stratified metrics by `Sex` and age bands (`<50`, `50-65`, `>65`) while flagging strata with `<30` cases as underpowered
Cover underpowered-stratum flagging and leakage exclusion in `backend/tests/test_smoke.py`
Update `docs/model-card.md` limitations section with subgroup interpretation guardrails
